concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but downstream tasks (e.g., T004, T005, T006) read the dataset files it creates. Running T001 in parallel with any consumer could cause a consumer‑before‑producer race, violating the foundational‑first rule. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` yet it writes to `data/processed/exclusions.json`, a file also written by T003 (and later tasks). This shared mutable state makes the task unsafe for parallel execution; the `[P]` tag must be removed or the exclusion logging must be made concurrency‑safe.
